**Key Findings:**

- Evidence suggests deliberate handling and examination of the item outside secure environments
- The container has been transported through high-risk locations without proper protective measures
- Access logs indicate the item has been left unattended in numerous unsecured areas, including public spaces and commercial districts

Sincerely,
Security Assessment Team
